hypothesis_provenance.economic_rationale: After five A-long large-cap single-factor lines were exhausted (full-main-board no_alpha; pure-quality falsified; cash_conversion clue-not-tradeable; low_volatility falsified; ep_value falsified), the statistically correct next step is ONE pre-registered batch that tests a diverse set of remaining large-cap-robust factors under Benjamini-Hochberg FDR, rather than more sequential singletons (which control within-factor but not across-factor multiple testing). The factor set spans value (book / cash-flow / sales to free-float price), earnings quality (low accruals, Sloan), investment (low asset growth, Fama-French CMA direction), profitability (ROA proxy), low risk (low beta BAB, low MAX lottery), and momentum (12-1, expected weak in China). All are documented large-cap-robust or are included to put a specific question to rest; A-share strong anomalies that concentrate in small/shell stocks are deliberately excluded because the user only trades the large-cap main board.

frozen_design.hypothesis_text: In a PIT A-share main-board top-500 large-cap universe (reusing the reviewed circ_mv materialization, the 000043 exclusion, and the reviewed full-main-board PIT fundamentals + restatement-ambiguity exclusion list), a frozen, diverse set of NINE primary factors plus ONE frozen-weight composite is tested in a single pre-registered batch for positive cost-adjusted excess versus CSI300 over a 504-trading-day hold. Each factor's standalone result is one primary cell; the across-factor decision is governed by Benjamini-Hochberg FDR over the ten primary p-values (nine factors + composite), with q=0.10 as the research-clue gate and q=0.05 reported as a stricter diagnostic. A factor is a research-only statistical alpha clue only if it survives FDR AND passes the per-factor robustness gates (positive mean net excess, both median sub-period halves positive, name/year concentration guards); a surviving clue is additionally a research-only tradeable candidate only if its rolling-overlapping-portfolio relative-NAV drawdown versus CSI300 is no worse than -15%. Diagnostics (252d, CSI1000, non-neutral, cap-weighted, single-factor cells) are reporting-only and cannot rescue. This is the agreed LAST structured batch / candidate-generation round: if no factor survives FDR with the robustness gates, A-share large-cap long in-sample alpha is downgraded to forward-live / a different market-or-data path, NOT rescued with new factor definitions. Even a surviving clue is research-only, is the program-level (5+k)-th test (FDR cannot uncount the five prior spent singletons), and requires forward-live validation.

composite.rationale: family-equal-weight so the three value variants do not dominate the composite; counted as the 10th primary hypothesis under FDR

required_output_diagnostics: Report all ten primary cells (nine factors + composite) with mean net excess, HAC t, p-value, monthly cohort count, both sub-period halves, and concentration guards.
Report the BH-FDR decision at q=0.10 (research-clue gate) and, as a stricter diagnostic, at q=0.05: the sorted p-values, the BH thresholds, and which primary cells survive each.
For every FDR-surviving clue, report the rolling-overlapping relative-NAV (strategy / CSI300) max drawdown and the tradeable-candidate label; absolute NAV drawdown is diagnostic only.
Report CSI1000, 252d, non-neutral, and cap-weighted cells as diagnostics that cannot define alpha or rescue a primary.
Report per-factor input-coverage counts (non-positive / insufficient-TTM / insufficient-trailing-window exclusions) and confirm fundamentals are PIT (ann_date <= as_of) and restatement-excluded.
Report the reviewed 000043.SZ / 20191129 exclusion + circ_mv backfill, top-500 PIT coverage, marginal industry/size coverage, and minimum top-count per month.
Report the restatement-exclusion application count (1504) and abort if missing or unapplied.

State the batch verdict against the stopping rule: if no factor survives FDR with the robustness gates, recommend downgrading A-share large-cap in-sample alpha to forward-live / pivot, not definition rescue.
Report no raw rows, endpoint results, request URL, or secret in any tracked summary.

statistical_alpha_clue: A future reviewed run may label a batch factor (or the composite) a research-only statistical alpha clue only if its single primary cell survives Benjamini-Hochberg FDR at q=0.10 across the ten primary p-values AND is positive net of costs versus CSI300, has at least 48 monthly cohorts, both median sub-period halves with positive mean excess, and passes the name / year concentration and PIT-hygiene gates.
q=0.05 is reported as a stricter diagnostic; surviving only at q=0.10 is still a research clue, not alpha proof.
tradeable_candidate_research_only: An FDR-surviving clue is additionally a research-only tradeable candidate only if its rolling-overlapping-portfolio relative-NAV (strategy / CSI300) max drawdown is no worse than -15%.
Even a tradeable-candidate label is research-only and cannot authorize production, ship-gate evidence, or full-size manual use.
falsified_or_downgrade: Any factor that does not survive FDR with the robustness gates is falsified within this batch under the frozen rules.

If NO factor survives, A-share large-cap long in-sample alpha is downgraded: route to forward-live validation or a different market / data path; do NOT rescue with new factor definitions, thresholds, horizons, benchmarks, universes, trailing windows, or composite weights.
Do not drop losing factors and re-run FDR on the survivors; the m=10 family is frozen.
diagnostics_policy: CSI1000, 252d, non-neutral, cap-weighted, and absolute-NAV drawdown are reporting diagnostics only and cannot define alpha or rescue a primary.
Diagnostics may inform a later new preregistration, but only through a new reviewed ledger update and user approval.
provenance_caveat: The batch is externally literature-motivated and tests a diverse factor set in one pre-registered round; BH-FDR controls within-batch family-wise error but cannot uncount the five prior spent singletons, so any survivor is the program-level (5+k)-th test.
It is tested on a single historical period (2018-2025); an in-sample survivor is a research clue only.
Real validation requires the unchanged forward-live ship gate; at least 12 months of forward-live evidence.

next_steps: Independent review (Codex) must validate this preregistration, schema, ledger, tests, and docs before any signal-search work.

After review PASS and commit, a separate batch signal-search runner slice may be implemented that reuses the vetted measurement chain, the reviewed top-500 universe, and the reviewed full-main-board PIT fundamentals to compute all nine factors + the composite, applies BH-FDR over the ten primary cells, and adds the rolling-overlapping relative-NAV drawdown gate for survivors.
The signal-search runner execution still requires its own independent review, commit, and a separate user execute; it spends this batch ledger exactly once.
No signal-search runner execution, new data fetch, provider call, DataHub work, production claim, ship-gate claim, or full-size use is authorized by this artifact.
limitations: This artifact registers a frozen batch design only; it executes no signal search and fetches no data.
The batch is the agreed LAST structured candidate-generation round; if it is dry, the project should downgrade A-share large-cap in-sample alpha rather than continue definition-rescue.
BH-FDR controls within-batch multiple testing but cannot uncount the five prior spent singletons; a survivor is the program-level (5+k)-th test and still requires forward-live evidence.

All denominators are circulating market cap (circ_mv), a free-float yield; factor ids use the *_to_circ_mv / free-float convention and must not be read as canonical book-to-market / EV / total-market-cap ratios.

roa_ttm is a profitability proxy, NOT Novy-Marx gross or Fama-French operating profitability (those fields are not materialized); it overlaps the already-falsified ROE-quality line and is the lowest-novelty slot.

low_beta and low_max are low-risk-family factors correlated with the already-falsified low_volatility line; momentum_12_1 is expected to be weak/reversal-prone in China large-cap and is included to settle the question.
Statistical power is limited: 504d holds over 2018-2025 give few non-overlapping windows, so each factor's HAC t rests on a short effective sample and FDR at m=10 sets a high bar.
Non-positive / insufficient-input names are excluded from each factor's scoring; trailing-window factors require a full window; cross-sectional percentiles make the circ_mv unit scale rank-invariant.
A positive future batch result remains research-only until the unchanged project ship gate, including at least 12 months of forward-live evidence, is satisfied.
